description: This file contains functions for sending, editing, deleting, and reading Matrix messages, including handling poll events and message summaries.

methods.name: sendMatrixMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified Matrix room with optional media, reply, and thread options.

methods.name: editMatrixMessage
methods.description: Edits an existing Matrix message identified by room and message IDs, requiring non-empty content.

methods.name: deleteMatrixMessage
methods.description: Deletes (redacts) a Matrix message in a specified room, with an optional reason.

methods.name: readMatrixMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages from a Matrix room, including handling poll events and summaries, with pagination support.
